app.name: Hexara
app.description: A 3D online strategy board game — claim land, gather resources and be the first to reach the victory target.

nav.themeDark: Dark theme — night on the board

home.heroSubtitle: A fully 3D board, complete rules, 2 to 6 players, and everything configurable.

board.title: Fully custom board
board.text: Board size, terrain distribution, hex numbers and port placement — lay it out by hand or roll it randomly, then share it with a seed code.

threeD.title: Smooth and three-dimensional
threeD.text: The board renders in WebGL with a free camera, soft shadows and animated dice and construction. Quality scales itself down on mobile.

rules.title: The complete rules
rules.text: Development cards, longest road, largest army, 2:1 and 3:1 ports, the robber, discarding — plus optional variants like the friendly robber.

realtime.title: Realtime and durable
realtime.text: Every move is validated on the server. Disconnected? Come back and the game resumes exactly where it was, with a bot covering your seat.

teams.title: Teams or free-for-all
teams.text: Create a room, invite friends with a code, split into teams and play for a shared score.

pwa.title: Install it on your phone
pwa.text: Hexara is a PWA — add it to your home screen and it behaves like a native app.

auth.guestNote: A guest account stays on this browser and can be upgraded later.
